entities.summary: Serhiy Anatoliiovych Petrenko is a Ukrainian-Russian retired ice hockey left wing. He was drafted in the seventh round, 168th overall, by the Buffalo Sabres in the 1993 NHL Entry Draft and played 14 games for Buffalo during the 1993–94 NHL season.
